title: Input guide
body: Kite feed guides set the width. Adjust both sides before use.

title: Supply inspection
body: Kite feed inspection checks stock. Record the width.

title: Kite paper jam
body: For a paper jam at tray one, unplug the unit and lift the tray.

title: Kite exit jam
body: For a jam in the exit path, open the rear latch after power is off.

title: Cover fit check
body: Moss cover clips keep dust outside. Check for loose clips.

title: Cover storage
body: Moss cover storage requires a dry shelf.

title: Moss cover cleaning
body: Wipe the shell with a dry cloth. Leave the power off.

title: Status lamp
body: The Reed status lamp stays amber while jobs wait.

title: Reed queue pause
body: A Reed queue pause lets the current job finish. Press the square button once.

title: Reed queue resume
body: Press the arrow button after the queue is clear.

title: Latch check
body: Frost fit checks apply to the latch only.

title: Shelf test
body: Use Frost fit marks to verify shelf alignment.

title: Frost cover gasket
body: Seat the gasket under the cover lip. Check all four corners.

title: Supply alignment
body: Birch feed guides hold the supply. Set the width first.

title: Feed log
body: The Birch feed log tracks the start of each shift.

title: Birch cartridge jam
body: For a jam at the cartridge, open the top flap after power is off.

title: Birch roller jam
body: For a roller jam, use the roller release after power is off.

title: Lark queue view
body: Lark queue status shows all jobs. The console lists the queue as a table.

title: Lark queue export
body: Lark queue export saves the current queue as a CSV file.

title: Finch gasket audit
body: The gasket audit examines tears and dry spots on the door.

title: Finch door gasket audit
body: File the gasket audit in the maintenance folder.

title: Inspection card 7
body: The Finch seal audit checks the serial mark on the anti-tamper label.
